title: Shift planning
subtitle: Who is on which shift this week. Draft it, publish it, then record every change so nothing is arranged by word of mouth.

week.notOpened: This week is not opened yet
week.notOpenedText: Open it to start placing people on its shifts.
week.notPublishedText: The roster appears here once it is published.
week.copyBody: Everyone on the previous week's roster is placed on the same shift this week. People already placed are kept; anyone no longer on the roster is skipped.
week.copied: {copied} placed · {skippedAlreadyPlaced} already placed · {skippedOffRoster} off the roster
week.clearBody: Takes all {people} people off this draft and removes its {tickets} tickets. Nothing published is affected.
week.publishBody: {people} people see their shift for the week. From then on every edit is recorded as a change.
week.publishEmpty: {count, plural, =1 {1 shift has} other {# shifts have}} nobody on it yet.
week.ledePublished: Published week: every change is recorded in the requests.
week.ledeDraft: Draft: nothing is visible to the teams before publication.

board.label: Roster
board.removeBody: {name} comes off the roster for this week. Their open tickets on it are removed.
board.ticketsRemoved: {count, plural, =1 {1 open ticket} other {# open tickets}} on the old shift removed
board.unplacedHint: Tap a shift letter to place the person.
board.off: No shift on {day} — tickets do not open that day.
board.placed: {count, plural, =1 {1 person} other {# people}} placed on {shift}

picker.title: Who works {shift}?
picker.publishedNote: The week is published: each addition is recorded as a change.
picker.summary: {count, plural, =1 {1 person selected} other {# people selected}}
picker.summaryMoving: {count, plural, =1 {, 1 changing shift} other {, # changing shift}}
picker.done: {count, plural, =1 {1 person} other {# people}} added to {shift}

requests.title: Shift requests
requests.acceptBody: The {kind} for {name} is applied to the roster now.
requests.sentencePending: {count, plural, =1 {One request awaits your answer.} other {# requests await your answer.}} Accepting applies the change to the roster for the rest of the week; refusing leaves the team as it is.
requests.sentenceNone: No pending request. Changes you make on a published week are also recorded here.
requests.emptyBody: No request matches this filter and search.

task.deleteBody: The ticket is removed. This cannot be undone.

me.title: My shifts
me.noEmployee: No employee record is linked to your account.
me.noEmployeeText: Ask an admin to link it on your employee record.

sentence.future: Next: {shift} shift{with}. {count, plural, =0 {No tasks planned yet.} =1 {1 task planned so far.} other {# tasks planned so far.}}

me.markLater: You can mark it done once the shift has started.

noSel.pick: Pick a task in the schedule.
noSel.none: No task on {day} yet. Your team lead adds them before the shift.

me.requestTitle: What would you like to change?
me.restOfWeek: For the rest of this week.
